records.scope: Known nonnegative vanilla cash-Gamma boundary kernel; unbounded raw payoff with finite Gaussian moments, not a new risk law.

C1_root_certificate.proof: Truncated-normal integration by parts gives variance strictly below lambda squared, so the positive slope has one peak inside the log-strike interval.

C2_root_certificate.proof: Exactly one strictly decreasing log-ratio root on each outside component; no stationary point between zero and a; both Gaussian tails vanish.
